I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread: "Thanks Marcus, noted: the signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. (Thistle) is due 24 December."

He said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. The workspace brain has already saved his message with the date and where he posted it. The deadline is a date, not a money figure, so it was fine to confirm in the channel.
